scope: Independent focused review of all 63 public passages, five writing witnesses and selected household or numerical claims. This is not certification of all 52 cited sources or every historical boundary.
result: No substantive unsupported writing or household claim found in the checked scope. Two small provenance/wording refinements and public punctuation cleanup recommended before integration.

findings.finding: Public prose still contains long dashes, including Krakow overview and orchard passage, Seven Zenden writing passage and date ranges.
